title: With the national debt nearing $40 trillion, Bank of America has a warning for bond investors
summary:
The U.S. national debt is hurtling toward $40 trillion, and Bank of America Research strategist Michael Hartnett's "Anything but Bonds" framework is becoming ever more applicable.
The U.S. national debt stands at roughly $39.9 trillion in mid-August and is expected to cross the $40 trillion threshold as early as this week.
This dynamic is already visible in the Treasury market.
